transcript.answer:
## Results

**Czech Wikipedia:** Interest in intermittent fasting is **declining significantly**. Views fell 47.7% over the last 12 months (September 2025–August 2026 compared to the same period a year earlier, with a 90% confidence range of -62.5% to -27.9%). Confidence is medium because the trend had some spikes of unknown cause on specific days (April 14 and August 15, 2025), though even removing those spikes shows a decline of -34.4%. The article gets about 146 views per month.

**Polish Wikipedia:** There's no dedicated article on intermittent fasting in Polish Wikipedia, so I can't measure it directly. However, I can offer two proxy options if you'd like:
- **"Post"** (fasting in general, Q44602) — broader concept that includes intermittent fasting
- **"Dieta"** (diet, Q474191) — even broader, covers all diets

These proxies measure a different topic than the Czech data, so they'd show interest in fasting or diet generally, not intermittent fasting specifically. Would you like me to include one of these proxies to give you a Polish comparison, even though it won't be directly comparable?
